Research and prototype AI assisted generative design workflows that combine data driven methods with physics and geometry aware reasoning. Build CAD integrated solutions within Siemens NX to enable pushbutton analysis, design exploration, and manufacturability checks. Design and validate methods that balance learning based approaches with deterministic evaluation, ensuring results are explainable and repeatable. Collaborate with cross functional partners in R&D, Manufacturing, Product Engineering and IT to transition research concepts into scalable engineering tools. Communicate research outcomes through technical reports, demonstrations, and presentations to engineering and leadership audiences.
